items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A green HTTP candidate served sauna and its gate passed; progress then halted at grading, 'Gondolin grading room is not implemented', with no file-verdicts or file-score instead of passing with 11 recorded effects.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at the fence, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the list showed R-1 once for C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: During R-1’s sleeping builder, start R-2 returned -32000 run-in-progress, R-2 progress was null and R-1 progress was running.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A gate-passing R-1 halted at grading instead of concluding passed, so the required passed-cycle setup could not be established; a subsequent R-2 for C-1 was nevertheless refused cycle-already-run.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Started R-1 with the syntactically valid nonexistent deadbeef commit; start returned -32000 not-a-commit and run-progress returned null, with no builder launch.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With an empty feature, start then progress showed checklist refused empty-checklist and the run halted at checklist before self-check or fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: Added an unstamped third scenario: stamp recorded 01-001 through 01-003, then progress showed halt at stamp for differing identities and no pin or checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: Self-check exited 1 with golden checklist differs; progress showed the cycle failed at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail, with self-check last and no fence or regenerate.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: Self-check printed SKIP bb-tools and exited 0; its passed event listed bb-tools, and the effect detail named it.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Fenced impl and absent harness/cycles: fence was refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by recorded fail-cycle; progress failed at fence for fence-refused without regenerate.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Fenced existing impl and harness/cycles; the builder logged an empty impl, plan and config in the object listing, one commit, and no impl or harness/cycles object path.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The red-then-green HTTP fixture produced two recorded builder sessions with different attempt-suffixed identities; regenerate completed before the failed gate and subsequent repair launch, and attempt 2 passed the gate.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder left a candidate and exited 1; regenerate recorded its digest and the HTTP gate passed, but the run halted at grading rather than passing with its cycle.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder exited 0 without producing files; progress showed no regenerate effect, a recorded fail-cycle, and failure at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder slept 30 seconds with regenerate timeout 2; it was stopped, no regenerate event was recorded, and progress failed at regenerate for budget.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Held the configured HTTP port open; attempt 1 recorded three seam-answered-before-boot refusals, each followed by gate-refusal, and failed at gate for infrastructure. The launch marker was absent.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: With one HTTP attempt, a red suite and a launch script that would create a marker, the gate recorded suite-red; no launch marker appeared and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: With one allowed HTTP attempt and a builder-produced executable test.sh but no start.sh, gate-attempt-failed was recorded for contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A green HTTP suite served a page without sauna, with one attempt; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed with detail page lacks marker.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The builder started a delayed write that changed its suite to red after exit; the installed copy passed its HTTP gate and its digest equalled regenerate's, while the builder room's suite had changed to exit 1.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: After the first red suite, the repair event named the first failed gate's evidence root and verification-repair; the second builder saw previous-candidate and gate-evidence, and attempts to write into each returned permission denied.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: The builder made red suites for all three attempts; its log showed exactly three sessions, the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted, no grader model call occurred, and no file-verdicts effect appeared.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: With the researcher scripted to fail on 01-002, the command gate passed but the runner halted at grading before any researcher call; neither file-verdicts nor file-score was recorded, so the requested one scored and one unreached result did not occur.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: On one store R-1 failed at the fence and R-2 halted at the empty checklist; later readings five seconds apart retained those statuses and their effect results matched the readings just after each start.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: Two progress queries for the same gate-passing run were identical, but that run had halted at unimplemented grading instead of passing, so the required still-passed Then did not hold.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The probe accepted only the full configured URL and a marker-bearing page, and the gate passed; the run then halted at grading rather than passing with its cycle.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The candidate's HTTP suite created and removed a directory under impl; the gate passed and install's candidate digest matched regenerate's.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The self-check printed the full legacy SKIP line; the passed event's skipped-checks and effect detail contained the whole text after SKIP.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With a green stdio suite, passing probe and store check, gate recorded a pass with 30 seconds, one poll, and the expected probe line; the run halted at grading with 'Gondolin grading room is not implemented' instead of passing.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio probe recorded its two arguments: the gate-room impl/start.sh absolute path and 30; its only store variable was GATE_STORE under the evidence directory outside the gate room. The store check received that exact path.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With one allowed attempt the stdio suite recorded its environment and exited 1; the gate recorded suite-red, the environment had neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ variables, and neither probe nor store-check log appeared.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A green stdio suite and a probe exiting 1 with the specified 30-second message yielded gate-attempt-failed identity-probe-failed with that message; the store check was not run.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With a passing stdio probe and a failing store check, gate recorded identity-probe-failed with the store-check line, and the one-attempt cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A stdio suite tested for plan/01-a/spec.feature from its working directory; gate passed and the install and regenerate digests were identical.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With passing stdio suite and probe but an empty store-check command, run-progress showed halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and no gate effect result.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs on one store used the same probe and config but store-check command suffixes one and two; both first self-checks passed and carried different harness digests.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: The 01-a symlink was stamped and the checklist named 01-001 and 01-002 with 01-a sources, but the run subsequently halted at grading instead of not halting.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With two slices and PLAN_SLICES=02, progress showed a single stamp for 02-001 and a checklist containing only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: With builder-clojure configured, both sessions logged its image path as third argument; the regenerate and repair effect details named builder-clojure and the same image digest.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Configured missing builder image with an empty images directory: start returned -32000 builder-image-missing and progress returned null.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two successive gate-passing runs shared one store and the second stamp recorded no new identities, but both halted at grading and the scoreboard query for C-2 returned null instead of reporting C-1 as previous.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The cut's harness/probe.sh read harness/config.sh relative to itself and checked the marker in the HTTP page; the gate passed and regenerate and install carried the same digest.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command logged one call in the project repo with the cut tree without impl, the separate candidate copy and an initially empty evidence directory; the pass event recorded 20 polls, 10 seconds, poll 3 and ledger answered as itself, with the copied candidate digest matching install and no candidate launch marker.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The gate command wrote receipt and returned suite-red 3 of 65 tests failed on attempt 1; the event preserved that reason and detail, the repair builder saw the receipt read-only, and attempt 2's gate passed.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command printed BOOT 20 10 and seam-answered-before-boot then exited 1: progress showed three refused gates each followed by a recorded gate-refusal, and failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command printed BOOT 20 10 and infrastructure the world did not come up, then exited 2; progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run and that detail, with no gate, fail-cycle, or cycle.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Three HTTP runs with no gate command, gate-a, and gate-b all passed their gates and their self-checks carried three distinct digests; the first matched SHA-256 of config bytes, the self-check command text, then probe bytes.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The green HTTP run's Grain store passed the reference check for its recorded effects and showed cycle.v1 and a gate-attempt child, but the run halted at grading and recorded only nine effects, not the required passing run and eleven leaves.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A server returned HTTP 503 to its first three requests; gate recorded a 10-second, 20-poll pass on poll 5. The regeneration-cycle progress query showed boot-margin-polls 15.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: The first HTTP suite failed and the second gate passed; the Grain reference reader found two successful gate-attempt.v1 runs. The parent run halted at unimplemented grading instead of passing with its cycle.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: Started a detached copy of the candidate against a fixture repo; its HTTP gate passed, but the run halted at grading with 'Gondolin grading room is not implemented' instead of passing.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: With the judge scripted for booked/pass and no receipt/fail, the gate passed but the runner halted at grading without scores, verdicts or score. The Grain reader showed only cycle.v1 and one gate-attempt child tick, and no grade.v1 ticks or judge scores.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher stub was set up to return E-ONE for the first item, but the gate-passing run halted at grading before any researcher or judge request, so no first-item judge request contained E-ONE.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher stub was set up to call vm_bash for its directory and files; after a passing gate the runner halted at grading before sending any researcher request or opening a grading-room shell.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: With the judge scripted to omit reasoning for 01-002, the gate passed but the run halted before any judge request; progress had no scores and the Grain reader found no judge score events, so neither 01-001’s score nor the requested unreached measurement was filed.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: Approved only r-1, not the computed rubric digest; progress halted at grader with refused-before-the-cycle and the actual sha256 digest, before self-check, fence or builder.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: With the model scripted to reject all researcher requests, the gate passed but the runner halted at grading before calling it; neither the zero-verdicts refusal nor fail-score-stage was recorded, and the run did not fail with its cycle.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: Killed the runner and sleeping builder five seconds into the first session, then restarted on the same store; the builder saw the same session identity twice and progress retained one pre-gate effect each, but after the gate passed the run halted at unimplemented grading rather than passing.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The render stub returned INSTRUCTION-7; the first copied instruction was exactly that text, while the repair's copied instruction added only a paragraph naming previous-candidate and gate-evidence, both read-only.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: With an unreachable model endpoint, render failed after the fence; progress halted at render for effect-could-not-run and had no regenerate effect.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: While the builder slept, run-progress showed a tick id with running status, completed fence then render, and regenerate as the final running node.
